```{r}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(arrow)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Ensure Catalog Pools Exist (Premium + F2P)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# If f2p_clean is not in your environment, pull it once:
if (!exists("f2p_clean")) {
  message("Pulling dedicated F2P pool from SteamSpy...")
  req_f2p <- request("https://steamspy.com/api.php?request=tag&tag=Free+to+Play") |>
    req_timeout(30) |>
    req_user_agent("UniversityDiscoveryProject/2.0 (academic research)")
  resp_f2p <- req_perform(req_f2p)
  data_f2p <- resp_body_json(resp_f2p)
  
  f2p_clean <- map_dfr(names(data_f2p), function(id) {
    item <- data_f2p[[id]]
    tibble(
      appid = as.integer(id),
      name = as.character(item$name %||% NA_character_),
      positive = as.integer(item$positive %||% 0),
      negative = as.integer(item$negative %||% 0),
      price_cents = 0L,
      owners_range = as.character(item$owners %||% "0 .. 0")
    )
  }) |>
    mutate(total_reviews = positive + negative) |>
    filter(total_reviews >= 100) |>
    mutate(
      positive_pct = (positive / total_reviews) * 100,
      base_price_usd = 0.0,
      is_free = 1L
    )
}

# Combine with your premium games pool
premium_pool <- catalog_clean |>
  filter(price_cents > 0) |>
  mutate(is_free = 0L)

f2p_pool <- f2p_clean |>
  filter(!appid %in% premium_pool$appid)

message("Available candidate pool: ", nrow(premium_pool), " Premium and ", nrow(f2p_pool), " F2P games.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Draw Sample Matching the Market Ratio (85% Premium / 15% F2P)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)

# Exactly 204 Premium (85%) and 36 Free-to-Play (15%) = 240 total games
target_premium <- 204
target_f2p <- 36

sampled_premium <- slice_sample(premium_pool, n = min(target_premium, nrow(premium_pool)))
sampled_f2p     <- slice_sample(f2p_pool, n = min(target_f2p, nrow(f2p_pool)))

sampled_games <- bind_rows(sampled_premium, sampled_f2p) |>
  slice_sample(prop = 1) # Shuffle order

message("Sample drawn: ", nrow(sampled_games), " total games (", 
        sum(sampled_games$is_free == 0), " Premium, ", 
        sum(sampled_games$is_free == 1), " F2P).")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Enrich Full Store Details for the 240 Sampled Games
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
fetch_full_storefront <- function(appid) {
  url <- paste0("https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids=", appid, "&cc=us&l=en")
  tryCatch({
    req <- request(url) |>
      req_timeout(12) |>
      req_user_agent("UniversityDiscoveryProject/2.0 (academic research)")
    
    resp <- req_perform(req)
    raw <- resp_body_json(resp)
    app_data <- raw[[as.character(appid)]]
    
    if (!isTRUE(app_data$success)) {
      return(list(success = FALSE, appid = appid))
    }
    
    d <- app_data$data
    short_desc <- d$short_description %||% ""
    about_game <- d$about_the_game %||% ""
    clean_text <- gsub("<.*?>", " ", paste(short_desc, about_game))
    clean_text <- gsub("\\s+", " ", clean_text)
    
    categories <- map_int(d$categories %||% list(), ~ .x$id %||% 0L)
    cat_35_flag <- if (35L %in% categories) 1L else 0L
    
    genres <- map_chr(d$genres %||% list(), ~ .x$description %||% "")
    raw_dlc_ids <- unlist(d$dlc %||% list())
    
    list(
      success = TRUE,
      appid = appid,
      store_name = d$name %||% NA_character_,
      cat_35_iap = cat_35_flag,
      primary_genre = if (length(genres) > 0) genres[1] else "Unknown",
      dlc_count_total = length(raw_dlc_ids),
      dlc_ids = head(raw_dlc_ids, 20),
      store_text = clean_text
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(success = FALSE, appid = appid)
  })
}

fetch_dlc_metadata <- function(dlc_id) {
  url <- paste0("https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids=", dlc_id, "&filters=basic,price_overview&cc=us&l=en")
  tryCatch({
    req <- request(url) |> req_timeout(6)
    resp <- req_perform(req)
    raw <- resp_body_json(resp)
    d <- raw[[as.character(dlc_id)]]$data
    name <- d$name %||% paste("DLC", dlc_id)
    price <- if (!is.null(d$price_overview$final_formatted)) d$price_overview$final_formatted else "Free/Included"
    paste0(name, " (", price, ")")
  }, error = function(e) {
    paste0("DLC ", dlc_id)
  })
}

message("Enriching the 240 sampled titles with store text and DLC names...")
enriched_records <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(sampled_games))) {
  target_id <- sampled_games$appid[i]
  if (i %% 25 == 0) message("  Enriched ", i, " / ", nrow(sampled_games), " games...")
  
  meta <- fetch_full_storefront(target_id)
  Sys.sleep(0.3)
  
  if (isTRUE(meta$success)) {
    dlc_summary_str <- "None"
    if (length(meta$dlc_ids) > 0) {
      dlc_names <- map_chr(meta$dlc_ids, function(did) {
        Sys.sleep(0.15)
        fetch_dlc_metadata(did)
      })
      dlc_summary_str <- paste(dlc_names, collapse = " | ")
    }
    meta$dlc_inventory_str <- dlc_summary_str
    meta$dlc_ids <- NULL
    enriched_records[[length(enriched_records) + 1]] <- as_tibble(meta)
  } else {
    # If a call fails or game is region-locked, provide fallback row
    enriched_records[[length(enriched_records) + 1]] <- tibble(
      success = TRUE, # keep row so sample size stays 240
      appid = target_id,
      store_name = sampled_games$name[i],
      cat_35_iap = 0L,
      primary_genre = "Unknown",
      dlc_count_total = 0L,
      store_text = "Store page unavailable via API",
      dlc_inventory_str = "None"
    )
  }
}

enriched_df <- bind_rows(enriched_records)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Generate the 4-Person Coding Sheet with 20% Overlap
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
coding_base <- sampled_games |>
  inner_join(enriched_df, by = "appid")

set.seed(101)
n_total <- nrow(coding_base)
n_overlap <- round(0.20 * n_total) # 48 double-coded games

shuffled_ids <- sample(coding_base$appid)
overlap_ids  <- head(shuffled_ids, n_overlap)
single_ids   <- tail(shuffled_ids, n_total - n_overlap)

coders <- c("Coder_A", "Coder_B", "Coder_C", "Coder_D")

single_coded_df <- tibble(
  appid = single_ids,
  primary_coder = rep(coders, length.out = length(single_ids)),
  secondary_coder = NA_character_
)

pair_combos <- list(
  c("Coder_A", "Coder_B"),
  c("Coder_B", "Coder_C"),
  c("Coder_C", "Coder_D"),
  c("Coder_D", "Coder_A")
)

overlap_coded_df <- tibble(
  appid = overlap_ids,
  primary_coder = map_chr(seq_along(overlap_ids), ~ pair_combos[[((.x - 1) %% 4) + 1]][1]),
  secondary_coder = map_chr(seq_along(overlap_ids), ~ pair_combos[[((.x - 1) %% 4) + 1]][2])
)

assignments <- bind_rows(single_coded_df, overlap_coded_df)

coding_sheet <- coding_base |>
  inner_join(assignments, by = "appid") |>
  select(
    appid,
    name,
    primary_coder,
    secondary_coder,
    is_free,
    base_price_usd,
    primary_genre,
    cat_35_iap_screening = cat_35_iap,
    dlc_count_total,
    dlc_inventory_str,
    store_text
  ) |>
  mutate(
    coder1_monetization_none = NA_integer_,
    coder1_cosmetic_only = NA_integer_,
    coder1_gameplay_advantage = NA_integer_,
    coder1_paywalled_content = NA_integer_,
    coder1_notes = NA_character_,
    coder2_monetization_none = NA_integer_,
    coder2_cosmetic_only = NA_integer_,
    coder2_gameplay_advantage = NA_integer_,
    coder2_paywalled_content = NA_integer_,
    coder2_notes = NA_character_
  )

dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(coding_sheet, "data/processed/hand_coding_master.csv", row.names = FALSE)
message("Success! Saved hand_coding_master.csv with exactly ", nrow(coding_sheet), " rows.")
```
